lines.1: 「I'm really sorry... I've learned my lesson... Why did I have to get so full of myself?」
lines.3: 「I-I do! From now on, every time I address you, I'll put 'handsome' in front!」
lines.4: 「Well, well. That's more like it, Samehyou!」
lines.5: 「Yes, sir! You have my absolute obedience!」
lines.6: 「(Like hell I'll obey you, you musclebound gorilla. Die. Drop dead right now. Damn it, if I were a superhero, I'd turn all of you into roast beef in seconds.)」
lines.9: 「All right. You can go home now.」
lines.10: 「Thank you for your mercy, handsome senior!」
lines.11: 「What a pathetic sight, Fukahire... You really hate getting punched that much?」
lines.12: 「Shut up. Who'd be dumb enough to talk straight with a gorilla?」
lines.13: 「Hey, senior! This guy's talking trash about you!」
lines.15: 「Hmph. Let them beat some guts into you. I'll save you if it looks like you're actually going to get hurt.」
lines.16: 「This is why I can't stand anyone from Class 2-A!」
